items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an injective sheaf of modules is injective as a presheaf of modules (statement lines 1769-1774). The proof identifies the forgetful functor as a right adjoint of the sheafification functor (proof lines 1776-1780) and applies the general fact that a right adjoint of an exact functor preserves injective objects (proof lines 1780-1784). The non-formal content is the exactness of sheafification, which is what makes the argument work. The claim is H2: one adjunction plus one formal consequence.
